records.explanation: 爾 is the second-person plural pronoun used by 太丘 (Chen Taiqiu) addressing his two sons 元方 and 季方. It refers to the two sons collectively, coreferring with 二人 and 二子, and is distinct from the father 太丘 and the guests.

二子 refers to the two sons 元方 and 季方, the children of 太丘 (Chen Taiqiu). The term 子 here is a genuine kinship term meaning 'son', and 二 indicates the two sons collectively. It corefers with 二人 and 爾, and is distinct from the father 太丘 and the guests.
季方 is a personal name, one of the two sons of 陳太丘. He is distinct from his brother 元方, and from his father (大人/太丘). He is part of the collective references 二人 and 二子.

assertions.interpretation: A guest came to stay overnight at Chen Taiqiu's home, establishing the scene time.
At that time Chen Taiqiu had his sons Yuanfang and Jifang cook, part of the ongoing scene.
The two sons abandoned the cooking fire and secretly listened, an event occurring during the scene.
Because they forgot the steaming mat, the rice fell into the pot, a consequence of the earlier neglect during the scene.
Yuanfang and Jifang knelt upright and explained, responding at that moment.
They state that the rice has now become congee, describing the present state resulting from the earlier event.
The sons say they roughly remembered what was said, referring to the content of the just-concluded conversation.

assertions.exact_span: 二子俱説更相易奪言無遺失
assertions.interpretation: The two sons both recounted and corrected each other without missing anything, an event following their listening within the scene.

assertion.exact_span: 太丘曰如此但糜自可何必飯也
